markdown_frontmatter.skills/qodo-get-rules/SKILL.md:
name: qodo-get-rules
description: Retrieve and apply Qodo coding rules relevant to implementation, planning, refactoring, or code review. Use on "get rules", "load qodo rules", or "relevant standards" and when starting a concrete coding task. Reuse rules already retrieved for the same workspace, repository, and task scope; refresh when that scope changes.
owner: Qodo
metadata:
  vendor: qodo
  version: "1.1.6"
  recommended: "false"
  package: "qodo-standards"
  distribution: "marketplace"
  instruction_mode: "embedded"
markdown_frontmatter.skills/qodo-manage-standards/SKILL.md:
name: qodo-manage-standards
description: Discover, configure, and manage Qodo Review Standards using managed tools through MCP or the CLI. Use to set up a skills/plugin repository for reviews, map review skills to target repositories, change skill scope or rules/steering mode, capture a convention as a rule, edit or deactivate rules, or triage suggestions. For reading and applying rules use qodo-get-rules; installing local coding-agent skills uses qodo-setup.
owner: Qodo
metadata:
  vendor: qodo
  version: "1.0.7"
  recommended: "false"
  package: "qodo-standards"
  distribution: "marketplace"
  instruction_mode: "embedded"
